in_sanskrit.name: भिमु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhīma-tāpra-kṛt, one who inflicts pain on Bhīma

in_tamil.name: பிமூ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Pim uṭaiyāḷam, one who possesses the strength of Bhīma

in_marathi.name: Bhimu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhimu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhimu is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'powerful' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Bhimu is the second eldest of the five Pandava brothers, known for his immense strength and courage. This name symbolizes bravery, wisdom, and compassion.
